content_sections.heading: About SPA Vijayawada
content_sections.text: School of Planning and Architecture, Vijayawada is an Institute of National Importance under the Ministry of Education, Government of India. It is located at Sy No.4/4, ITI Road, Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh.

content_sections.heading: SPA Vijayawada Assistant Professor Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The number of vacancies is likely to increase or decrease as per requirement, at the sole discretion of the institute. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

rows.pay: Consolidated Rs. 65,000/- p.m. with P.G. Degree; Rs. 70,000/- p.m. with Ph.D Degree

content_sections.heading: SPA Vijayawada Assistant Professor Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet one of these two conditions: Bachelor's Degree in Architecture and Master's Degree in Architecture/Conservation/Landscape Architecture/Urban Design/Building Engineering Management/Master of Design/General Architecture/Environmental Architecture/Interior Design/Any relevant Master's in the field of Architecture, with First Class or equivalent either in Bachelor's or Master's Degree. Bachelor's Degree in Architecture and Master's Degree in Planning (with any specialization), with First Class or equivalent either in Bachelor's or Master's Degree. Equivalence of First Class is a minimum of 60% marks in aggregate, if class or division is not awarded. One (01) year experience in teaching and/or research or industry in a reputed organization. Specialization in Architecture/Design at PG level of M.Arch Architectural Conservation/Landscape Architecture/Sustainable Architecture/M.Urban Design/M.Design/General Architecture. Papers presented at Conference and/or in referred journals. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Verification of documents, where candidates also hand in the filled application. Walk-in interview on the same day. Candidates may be required to make a Power Point Presentation on a topic of their interest, with a maximum of 5 slides.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The posts are temporary in nature and purely on contract basis (ad-hoc/contract). The initial tenure is six months, extendable from time to time depending on requirement and satisfactory performance.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SPA Vijayawada Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the website www.spav.ac.in . Fill in the form completely. Report to School of Planning and Architecture, Vijayawada, Sy No.4/4, ITI Road, Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh, within the reporting time. Submit the filled application with photocopies of all documents on qualifications, experience etc. at document verification, before the walk-in interview. Produce the original documents for verification. UG, PG and Ph.D Degree Certificates and Marks Sheets Experience Certificates Details of papers presented at Conferences/referred journals in brief CoA Registration, if applicable Identity proof issued by GoI SSC/DoB certificate and Passport size Photograph

faq.question: Q1. What if my university does not award a class or division?
faq.answer: A minimum of 60% marks in aggregate is treated as equivalent to First Class.

faq.question: Q2. Can a candidate with a Master's Degree in Planning attend?
faq.answer: Yes, with a Bachelor's Degree in Architecture. Any Planning specialization is accepted, with First Class or equivalent in either degree.

faq.question: Q3. Is teaching experience compulsory?
faq.answer: No. One year of experience in teaching and/or research or industry in a reputed organization is listed as desirable, not essential.

faq.question: Q4. Does a Ph.D increase the pay?
faq.answer: Yes. The consolidated remuneration is Rs. 5,000 higher than the P.G. rate.

faq.question: Q5. What must candidates with a foreign degree produce?
faq.answer: They should produce an Equivalence Certificate from the Association of Indian Universities (AIU), New Delhi.

faq.question: Q6. How long can the presentation be?
faq.answer: If a presentation is asked for, it can have a maximum of 5 slides, and the candidate chooses the topic.

faq.question: Q7. Will the institute pay travel costs for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The institute will not pay TA/DA to candidates appearing for the interview.
